// Code generated by Termwright. DO NOT EDIT - Termwright writes this file again when tests are saved.

// Package twtest is the helper library of Termwright's generated Go tests: it sends each step to the
// running Termwright (its local API: commands log in with the sessions' saved logins, requests go
// through API sessions) and checks the answers. Only the Go standard library is used.
//
// Settings: TERMWRIGHT_API and TERMWRIGHT_KEY (else mcp.json in Termwright's data folder);
// -tw.var name=value (repeatable) and -tw.testbed file (lines "name: value") set {{variables}}.
package twtest

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type varFlags map[string]string

func (v varFlags) String() string { return "" }
func (v varFlags) Set(s string) error {
	k, x, ok := strings.Cut(s, "=")
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("-tw.var %q: want name=value", s)
	}
	v[strings.TrimSpace(k)] = x
	return nil
}

var (
	flagVars    = varFlags{}
	flagTestbed = flag.String("tw.testbed", "", "a testbed file: lines \"name: value\" used as {{variables}}")
)

func init() { flag.Var(flagVars, "tw.var", "name=value for {{name}} (repeatable)") }

// T runs one test case: its steps in order; after a failed step the rest are skipped unless
// that step continues on failure.
type T struct {
	t       *testing.T
	Vars    map[string]string
	stopped bool
}

// New starts a test case with its own variables; the testbed's and -tw.var values win.
func New(t *testing.T, vars map[string]string) *T {
	v := map[string]string{}
	for k, x := range vars {
		v[k] = x
	}
	if *flagTestbed != "" {
		f, err := os.Open(*flagTestbed)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("testbed: %v", err)
		}
		sc := bufio.NewScanner(f)
		for sc.Scan() {
			l := strings.TrimSpace(sc.Text())
			if k, x, ok := strings.Cut(l, ":"); ok && l != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(l, "#") {
				v[strings.TrimSpace(k)] = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(x), `"'`)
			}
		}
		f.Close()
	}
	for k, x := range flagVars {
		v[k] = x
	}
	return &T{t: t, Vars: v}
}

// Step runs one step as a subtest.
func (c *T) Step(name string, continueOnFail bool, fn func(s *Step)) {
	name = c.Fill(name)
	if c.stopped {
		c.t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) { t.Skip("an earlier step failed") })
		return
	}
	ok := c.t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) { fn(&Step{T: t, c: c}) })
	if !ok && !continueOnFail {
		c.stopped = true
	}
}

var varRe = regexp.MustCompile(`\{\{\s*([\w.\-]+)\s*\}\}`)

// Fill replaces {{name}} with its value; unknown names stay.
func (c *T) Fill(s string) string {
	return varRe.ReplaceAllStringFunc(s, func(m string) string {
		if x, ok := c.Vars[varRe.FindStringSubmatch(m)[1]]; ok {
			return x
		}
		return m
	})
}

// Step is one step's subtest.
type Step struct {
	*testing.T
	c *T
}

// Request is an HTTP step.
type Request struct {
	Session, Environment, Collection, Method, URL, Body string
	Headers                                             map[string]string
	Timeout                                             int // seconds
}

// SNMP is an SNMP step (op get, getnext, bulk, walk or set).
type SNMP struct {
	Session, Op string
	OIDs        []string
	Values      []SetValue
	Timeout     int // seconds
}

// SetValue is a value an SNMP set writes.
type SetValue struct{ OID, Type, Value string }

type snmpRow struct{ OID, Name, Value, Display string }

// Answer is what a step got.
type Answer struct {
	Rows   []snmpRow `json:"rows"`
	s      *Step
	Output string `json:"output"`
	Status int    `json:"status"`
	Ms     int64  `json:"ms"`
	Error  string `json:"error"`
}

// Run sends a command on a saved session (prompt "" = its device type's).
func (s *Step) Run(session, command, prompt string, timeout int) *Answer {
	s.Helper()
	return s.send(map[string]any{"run": map[string]any{"session": s.c.Fill(session), "command": s.c.Fill(command), "prompt": prompt}, "timeout": timeout})
}

// HTTP sends a request.
func (s *Step) HTTP(r Request) *Answer {
	s.Helper()
	h := map[string]string{}
	for k, v := range r.Headers {
		h[k] = s.c.Fill(v)
	}
	return s.send(map[string]any{"http": map[string]any{"session": s.c.Fill(r.Session), "environment": s.c.Fill(r.Environment), "collection": s.c.Fill(r.Collection),
		"method": r.Method, "url": s.c.Fill(r.URL), "headers": h, "body": s.c.Fill(r.Body)}, "timeout": r.Timeout})
}

// SNMP runs an SNMP operation with a saved session's SNMP settings.
func (s *Step) SNMP(r SNMP) *Answer {
	s.Helper()
	oids := make([]string, len(r.OIDs))
	for i, o := range r.OIDs {
		oids[i] = s.c.Fill(o)
	}
	vals := []map[string]string{}
	for _, v := range r.Values {
		vals = append(vals, map[string]string{"oid": s.c.Fill(v.OID), "type": v.Type, "value": s.c.Fill(v.Value)})
	}
	return s.send(map[string]any{"snmp": map[string]any{"session": s.c.Fill(r.Session), "op": r.Op, "oids": oids, "values": vals}, "timeout": r.Timeout})
}

// OID: an SNMP value by name (ifOperStatus.5, IF-MIB::ifOperStatus.5, ifOperStatus = the first) or
// numeric OID. Equals matches its readable value (up) or its raw value (1).
func (a *Answer) OID(oid string) *Value {
	o := strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(a.s.c.Fill(oid)), ".")
	v := &Value{s: a.s, what: "oid " + o}
	pick := func(r snmpRow) *Value { v.Text, v.raw, v.Found = r.Display, r.Value, true; return v }
	for _, r := range a.Rows {
		if r.OID == o || r.Name == o {
			return pick(r)
		}
	}
	for _, r := range a.Rows {
		n := r.Name
		if _, after, ok := strings.Cut(n, "::"); ok && !strings.Contains(o, "::") {
			n = after
		}
		if n == o || strings.HasPrefix(n, o+".") || strings.HasPrefix(r.OID, o+".") {
			return pick(r)
		}
	}
	return v
}

func (s *Step) send(step map[string]any) *Answer {
	s.Helper()
	a := &Answer{s: s}
	api, key, err := Endpoint()
	if err != nil {
		s.Fatal(err)
	}
	b, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"action": "step", "step": step})
	req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", api+"/tools/tests", bytes.NewReader(b))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+key)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	res, err := (&http.Client{Timeout: 15 * time.Minute}).Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		s.Fatalf("Termwright: %v", err)
	}
	defer res.Body.Close()
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
	var out struct {
		Result string `json:"result"`
		Detail string `json:"detail"`
	}
	json.Unmarshal(body, &out)
	if res.StatusCode != 200 {
		s.Fatalf("Termwright: %s %s", res.Status, out.Detail)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out.Result), a); err != nil {
		s.Fatalf("Termwright: %v", err)
	}
	if a.Error != "" {
		s.Fatalf("%s", a.Error)
	}
	return a
}

// Endpoint is the local API address (up to /api/v1) and its key.
func Endpoint() (string, string, error) {
	if u, k := os.Getenv("TERMWRIGHT_API"), os.Getenv("TERMWRIGHT_KEY"); u != "" && k != "" {
		return strings.TrimRight(u, "/"), k, nil
	}
	dir := os.Getenv("TERMWRIGHT_HOME")
	if dir == "" {
		home, _ := os.UserHomeDir()
		switch runtime.GOOS {
		case "darwin":
			dir = filepath.Join(home, "Library", "Application Support", "Termwright")
		case "windows":
			dir = filepath.Join(os.Getenv("APPDATA"), "Termwright")
		default:
			dir = filepath.Join(home, ".config", "Termwright")
		}
	}
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "mcp.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("Termwright is not running with its Local API on (%v); or set TERMWRIGHT_API and TERMWRIGHT_KEY", err)
	}
	var ep struct{ URL, Token string }
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &ep); err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	return strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimRight(ep.URL, "/"), "/mcp") + "/api/v1", ep.Token, nil
}

// Contains: the output has the text.
func (a *Answer) Contains(text string) *Answer {
	a.s.Helper()
	if t := a.s.c.Fill(text); !strings.Contains(a.Output, t) {
		a.s.Errorf("expected the output to contain %q\n%s", t, a.Output)
	}
	return a
}

// NotContains: the output does not have the text.
func (a *Answer) NotContains(text string) *Answer {
	a.s.Helper()
	if t := a.s.c.Fill(text); strings.Contains(a.Output, t) {
		a.s.Errorf("expected the output not to contain %q", t)
	}
	return a
}

// Matches: the output matches the regular expression.
func (a *Answer) Matches(pattern string) *Answer {
	a.s.Helper()
	re, err := regexp.Compile(a.s.c.Fill(pattern))
	if err != nil {
		a.s.Errorf("bad pattern %q: %v", pattern, err)
	} else if !re.MatchString(a.Output) {
		a.s.Errorf("expected the output to match %s\n%s", re, a.Output)
	}
	return a
}

// StatusIs: the HTTP status.
func (a *Answer) StatusIs(code int) *Answer {
	a.s.Helper()
	if a.Status != code {
		a.s.Errorf("expected status %d, got %d", code, a.Status)
	}
	return a
}

// MaxMs: the step took at most ms milliseconds.
func (a *Answer) MaxMs(ms int64) *Answer {
	a.s.Helper()
	if a.Ms > ms {
		a.s.Errorf("expected at most %d ms, took %d ms", ms, a.Ms)
	}
	return a
}

// Field: the first group of the regular expression (else the match) in the output.
func (a *Answer) Field(pattern string) *Value {
	p := a.s.c.Fill(pattern)
	v := &Value{s: a.s, what: "field " + p}
	if re, err := regexp.Compile(p); err == nil {
		if m := re.FindStringSubmatch(a.Output); m != nil {
			v.Text, v.Found = m[len(m)-1], true
			if len(m) > 1 {
				v.Text = m[1]
			}
		}
	}
	return v
}

// JSON: the value at a path in the JSON body (a.b[0].c, ["key"], [-1], length).
func (a *Answer) JSON(path string) *Value {
	p := a.s.c.Fill(path)
	v := &Value{s: a.s, what: "json " + p}
	var doc any
	if json.Unmarshal([]byte(a.Output), &doc) == nil {
		if x, ok := jsonPath(doc, p); ok {
			v.Found = true
			switch t := x.(type) {
			case string:
				v.Text = t
			case nil:
				v.Text = "null"
			case float64:
				v.Text = strconv.FormatFloat(t, 'f', -1, 64)
			case bool:
				v.Text = strconv.FormatBool(t)
			default:
				j, _ := json.Marshal(t)
				v.Text = string(j)
			}
		}
	}
	return v
}

// Value is a field or JSON value to check.
type Value struct {
	s     *Step
	what  string
	Text  string
	Found bool
	raw   string // an SNMP value's raw value
}

func (v *Value) num() (float64, error) {
	t := v.Text
	if v.raw != "" {
		t = v.raw
	}
	return strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimSpace(t), 64)
}

// Save keeps the value as {{name}} for later steps.
func (v *Value) Save(name string) *Value {
	if v.Found {
		v.s.c.Vars[name] = v.Text
	}
	return v
}

// Exists: the value is there (or not).
func (v *Value) Exists(want bool) *Value {
	v.s.Helper()
	if v.Found != want {
		v.s.Errorf("%s: expected exists = %v", v.what, want)
	}
	return v
}

// Equals: the value is exactly want.
func (v *Value) Equals(want string) *Value {
	v.s.Helper()
	if w := v.s.c.Fill(want); !v.Found || (v.Text != w && (v.raw == "" || v.raw != w)) {
		v.s.Errorf("%s: expected %q, got %q", v.what, w, v.Text)
	}
	return v
}

// NotEquals: the value is not want.
func (v *Value) NotEquals(want string) *Value {
	v.s.Helper()
	if w := v.s.c.Fill(want); v.Text == w || (v.raw != "" && v.raw == w) {
		v.s.Errorf("%s: expected not %q", v.what, w)
	}
	return v
}

// Greater: the value is a number above n.
func (v *Value) Greater(n float64) *Value {
	v.s.Helper()
	if x, err := v.num(); err != nil || !v.Found || x <= n {
		v.s.Errorf("%s: expected > %g, got %q", v.what, n, v.Text)
	}
	return v
}

// Less: the value is a number below n.
func (v *Value) Less(n float64) *Value {
	v.s.Helper()
	if x, err := v.num(); err != nil || !v.Found || x >= n {
		v.s.Errorf("%s: expected < %g, got %q", v.what, n, v.Text)
	}
	return v
}

// IsFound: the value is there.
func (v *Value) IsFound() *Value { return v.Exists(true) }

var pathPart = regexp.MustCompile(`([^.\[\]]+)|\[(\d+|-1)\]|\["([^"]*)"\]`)

func jsonPath(doc any, path string) (any, bool) {
	path = strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(path), "$"), ".")
	cur := doc
	for _, m := range pathPart.FindAllStringSubmatch(path, -1) {
		if m[2] != "" {
			a, ok := cur.([]any)
			if !ok {
				return nil, false
			}
			i, _ := strconv.Atoi(m[2])
			if i < 0 {
				i += len(a)
			}
			if i < 0 || i >= len(a) {
				return nil, false
			}
			cur = a[i]
			continue
		}
		k := m[1]
		if m[3] != "" {
			k = m[3]
		}
		switch t := cur.(type) {
		case map[string]any:
			x, ok := t[k]
			if !ok {
				if k == "length" {
					return float64(len(t)), true
				}
				return nil, false
			}
			cur = x
		case []any:
			if k != "length" {
				return nil, false
			}
			return float64(len(t)), true
		default:
			return nil, false
		}
	}
	return cur, true
}
